tolerance_freeze_note: All acceptance thresholds below were written to this file BEFORE any numerical result was computed or inspected. They are not tuned to outcomes.

sample.benchmark_note: mom dropped per author; FF5 = mkt,smb,hml,rmw,cma; CAPM = mkt. Center covariance via np.cov(rowvar=False) for benchmark weights only.

conventions.W: W in R^10 nonnegative ridge-basis MIXING coefficients (no sum-to-1 constraint); QP argmax W'u - 0.5 W'QW s.t. W_j >= 0
conventions.pi: pi in R^153 final asset (factor) weights = eff_port @ W * scale
conventions.second_moment: UNCONTENTERED S = X'X/T (no demeaning) for the ridge basis; LOO moments remove one row and divide by c (B0 c=T, B1 c=T-1)
conventions.loo_stable_expression: K = X X'; G_c = (K + c*z*I)^(-1); a_t = 1 - (G_c @ 1)_t / diag(G_c)_t
conventions.loo_A_matrix: A[t,j] = a_t(z_j); u = mean(A,axis=0); Q = A'A/T
conventions.trace_scale: scale = sum(1/inv_eigs) / sum(eigenvalues), inv_eigs = W @ 1/(eig[:,None] + z[None,:]); eigenvalues are of K/T (T-dim)
conventions.eff_port_full_basis: eff_port[:,j] = X' (K + T*z_j I)^(-1) 1, i.e. (X'X/T + z_j I)^(-1) X'1 ; full-window ridge basis keeps ORIGINAL T for BOTH B0 and B1 (frozen)
conventions.oos_return: r_{t} = X[t] @ pi_{t-1}; training window ends t-1, attribution to month t
conventions.turnover: per src/metrics.py: gross=w.abs().sum(axis=1); 0.5*|w.diff().abs().sum(axis=1)|/gross.shift(); first month = 0; x100
conventions.alpha: per src/plotting.py::_alpha_one: scale y and X each by annual_vol/std(sqrt(12)*series) with annual_vol=0.1, OLS const + regressor with HAC(5), alpha=const*12*100 (percentage points)
conventions.pricing_R2: per src/pricing.py::r_2_table_gen with SDF scaling; per-theme pooled std, 'All' per-column std; JKP clusters from src/constants.py

numerics.eigendecomposition: numpy.linalg.eigh on symmetric K = X@X.T (T-dim); clip tiny negative eigenvalues to 0 before forming 1/(eig+c*z)
numerics.qp_solver: cvxopt.solvers.qp (P=Q, q=-u, G=-I, h=0), abstol=1e-7, reltol=1e-6, feastol=1e-7, maxiters=100 (author library defaults)
numerics.qp_independent_crosscheck: scipy.optimize.minimize SLSQP on first window only
numerics.kkt_residual: max(max(0,-W), |min(W, Q@W - u + lambda)|, |lambda*W|) using multiplier lambda from active-set/cvxopt
numerics.direct_refit: for each left-out row t and divisor d, form X_(-t), S_(-t)=X_(-t)'X_(-t)/d, m_(-t)=X_(-t)'1/d, solve (S_(-t)+zI)p=m_(-t) with numpy.linalg.solve; A_tj = X[t] @ p

loo_equivalence_high_z.pass_rule: maxabs <= abs_tol OR relative_error <= rel_tol for all z >= 1e-7

loo_equivalence_low_z.note: Low-z conditioning is known sensitive (protocol section 2.1). Record errors and condition numbers; flag SENSITIVE_LOW_Z if maxabs > sensitivity_flag_abs. Do NOT use low-z to fail the algebra-equivalence verdict, but DO report it.

author_A_vs_B0.unit: monthly return decimal and weight units

tolerances.finite_check: all 494 OOS returns and all weights must be finite; any NaN/Inf => execution_status FAILED
